title: group_and_receipt: read_at presence checked but timestamp value not verified
description: group_and_receipt.rs step 9: asserts alice_msg.read_at.is_some() but does not assert the value equals the read_timestamp from the receipt (2026-01-01T12:00:00Z). A bug that stored the local clock time instead of the peer-supplied at field would pass this test. Since the spec mandates the peer-reported read timestamp is preserved, the test must assert the exact value.
